description: Create or change a text variable (Type > Text Variables > Define): custom text, file name, last page number, chapter number, creation / modification / output date with its format, running header from a paragraph or character style, or a metadata caption; with text before and after.

name.description: Variable name; created when it does not exist

options.description: Options for the type; only the ones given change

characterStyle.description: running_header_character: the character style to pick up

dateFormat.description: Dates: a date pattern such as "MMMM d, yyyy" or "dd/MM/yy h:mm a"

deleteEndPunctuation.description: Running headers: delete punctuation at the end

numberFormat.description: last_page_number, chapter_number: number style (CURRENT follows the section or chapter setting)

paragraphStyle.description: running_header_paragraph: the paragraph style to pick up

scope.description: last_page_number: last page of the document or of the section

textAfter.description: Text after the value (every type except custom_text)

textBefore.description: Text before the value (every type except custom_text)

use.description: Running headers: use the first or last match on the page

name: define_text_variable
title: Define Text Variable
